name: The Fern Seaside Luxurious Tent Resort Daman (Series by Marriott)
why_pick: 100m from Light House Beach, walking distance to Jampore Beach and the Moti Daman fort ramparts — the only Daman property where you can stroll to two beaches and a Portuguese fort in one morning. Winter Green premium tents with proper plumbing, AC, and high-speed Wi-Fi; eco-styled but not stripped down. Series-by-Marriott brand standards keep the kitchen and front-desk consistent.
what_to_know: Beach is rocky in spots near the lighthouse — Jampore (5min walk) is the better swimming option. Property runs full-board options that include the in-house multi-cuisine restaurant.
best_for: Couples and families wanting fort + beach access without the Devka Beach noise
address_or_landmark: Light House Beach, Moti Daman, Daman 396210

name: Hotel Kohinoor
why_pick: Diu's first resort, opened decades ago and continuously run since — 50 rooms across 3.5 acres in Fofrara-Fudam village, Portuguese-influenced architecture (arched verandas, tiled-roof cottages), and walking distance to the Gangeshwar Mahadev temple sea-rocks. Sits between Diu town and Nagoa Beach, halfway-point location that suits visitors splitting time between fort, beach, and offbeat sights.
what_to_know: Older property — rooms are spacious and clean but not boutique-modern. Pool-facing rooms are the upgrade pick. Restaurant is decent but Diu town's O Coqueiro is a 5-minute drive for the better dinner option.
best_for: Families and heritage-seekers who want fort-and-temple proximity without staying in Old Town

name: Khanvel Resort
why_pick: Silvassa's most-loved weekend resort — 156 rooms plus 18 sylvan cottages with private patios and 2 plunge-pool bungalows on a forested 25-acre estate at Khanvel, 18km south-east of Silvassa town. Pure-vegetarian and Jain-friendly kitchen, mini water park for kids, 9-hole mini golf course, and the only Silvassa property where you can walk into actual Sahyadri-foothill forest from your patio. Tripadvisor #3 of 12 hotels in Silvassa.
what_to_know: Pure-veg only — meat-eaters must drive to Silvassa town for non-veg dinner. Water park busy on weekend afternoons; weekday stays are quieter. Pairs well with Vasona Lion Safari (12km away).
best_for: Families with kids, weekend Mumbai/Surat groups wanting forest atmosphere
address_or_landmark: Khanvel Resort, Khanvel-Silvassa Road, Khanvel, Silvassa, Dadra & Nagar Haveli 396230

name: Treat Resort Silvassa
why_pick: A 4-star leisure resort with 60+ rooms in central Silvassa — outdoor pool, fitness centre, dedicated kids' arcade, and an in-house adventure park. Treat Resorts is a Gujarat-rooted hospitality group; Silvassa is one of their flagship properties. Reasonable mid-range pricing, family-friendly programming, and the in-house multi-cuisine restaurant means you don't need to leave for dinner.
what_to_know: Town location — convenient for Vanganga Garden, Tribal Museum, and Vasona Lion Safari (all <10km). Property busier than Khanvel but cheaper. Adventure park has rope course, archery, ziplining included for guests.
best_for: Budget-conscious families, group bookings, weekend stays from Mumbai
address_or_landmark: Treat Resort, Silvassa, Dadra & Nagar Haveli 396230

name: Ras Resort by Treat
why_pick: On the banks of the Daman Ganga river inside Silvassa city limits — the only hotel where you can walk to Vanganga Lake Garden (4km) and have a riverside breakfast terrace. Surrounded by lush gardens, with an outdoor pool, fitness centre, and full-service spa. The in-house Bistro restaurant is one of Silvassa's most-booked sit-down dinners. Operated under the Keys Select brand which keeps service consistent.
what_to_know: Quieter than Khanvel and Treat — fewer kids' activities, more adult-couple atmosphere. The riverside view is best in monsoon (July-September) when the Daman Ganga is full; dries to a trickle by March.
best_for: Couples and corporate stays wanting riverside calm with town-centre access
address_or_landmark: Ras Resort by Treat, Daman Ganga Riverside, Silvassa, Dadra & Nagar Haveli 396230
